newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- SNET cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- SNET cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers cut its rating of Southern New England Telecommunications Corp to a neutral from outperform.
-- 1997 estimates were cut by a nickel, to $3.20 earnings per share from $3.25, and the 12 month price target for the stock was cut to $41 from $45.
-- In a research report, Lehman said that based on discussions with SNET management, it expects higher operating and maintenance expenses in the fourth quarter and 1997.
-- Lehman also cited future expected but unquantified costs for updating the computer infrastructure at SNET which "could dim the outlook of double-digit earnings growth".
-- Lehman also said it expects competition to accelerate, putting more pressure on operating margins.
